name: Announcement banner
description: A banner at the top of every page of the site to announce an event, a maintenance or a wipe, with a link and a click counter.
author: PalCMS

settings.label: Message
settings.default: Welcome to the server! Join us on Discord.

settings.label: Link (optional)
settings.description: Address opened on click, e.g. /events or https://discord.gg/…

settings.label: Show until (optional)
settings.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD: the banner disappears on its own after that day.
